briefdescription.para: The blend operation is a User of the incoming values and of their respective masks, ordered [I0, M0, I1, M1, I2, M2, ...].

detaileddescription.para: Note that M0 can be omitted (implied by passing an odd number of operands) in which case all other incoming values are merged into it.

briefdescription.para: A normalized blend is one that has an odd number of operands, whereby the first operand does not have an associated mask.
Return the number of incoming values, taking into account when normalized the first incoming value will have no mask.
Return the cost of this VPWidenMemoryRecipe.
Returns true if the recipe only uses the first lane of operand Op.
A recipe for vectorizing a phi-node as a sequence of mask-based select instructions.
